rows.title: Processor prefixes are the same merchant
rows.defect: the PAYPAL * prefix is not stripped, so one subscription reads as two
rows.test: PAYPAL *SPOTIFY and SPOTIFY are one subscription

rows.title: Store numbers are not the merchant
rows.defect: trailing store numbers and references are kept
rows.test: NETFLIX.COM #4471 and NETFLIX.COM 866-579-7172 are one key

rows.title: Only posted spend
rows.defect: the spend filter checks only the sign
rows.test: card autopay, transfers and pending rows never repeat as subscriptions

rows.title: Never sample data
rows.defect: the live gate is dropped, so monitors run on whatever rows they are given
rows.test: runAll with isLive false reads no transaction

rows.title: Names through MerchantLabel
rows.defect: the raw descriptor is the display name
rows.test: HEADSPACE reply with your password shows as HEADSPACE

rows.title: Two plans are two charges
rows.defect: the amount tolerance is $10, so two plans blur into one irregular charge

rows.title: Cadence and next date
rows.defect: a month is taken as 30 days
rows.test: a monthly charge on Oct 1 is next due Nov 1

rows.title: Three of four gaps keep the rhythm
rows.test: an irregular same-amount gym charge is not a subscription

rows.title: Dormant is not money to cut
rows.test: Hulu, last charged 103 days ago, is not offered

rows.title: Coffee and rides are not subscriptions
rows.defect: the not-a-subscription list is not checked
rows.test: weekly Starbucks, Uber and Chevron are not listed

rows.title: Refunds netted
rows.defect: refunds already back are not subtracted

rows.title: Same account, same day
rows.defect: the account is left out of the grouping
rows.test: the same amount on two cards is not a duplicate

rows.title: Never a past dispute date
rows.defect: the date is always day 45, already gone after it (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a 50-day-old duplicate says the 60-day close, not day 45

rows.title: A rise at its own cadence
rows.defect: every rise is called a monthly one (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a $10 weekly rise is $43.33 a month

rows.title: Bank fees inside 60 days
rows.test: a 72-day-old service fee is not raised
